This confirms that the authentication issue is due to stale credentials being used in the CI pipeline. This directly supports the **CI misconfiguration hypothesis (H2)**, as the pipeline is likely still using the old token value instead of the updated one. It also suggests a lack of automated token refresh or secret management in the CI setup. The next step is to update the token in the CI configuration or secret store and verify if this resolves the publish-image step failure.
